purpose: Connected-dot context graph for public Irish housing and planning data. It links ingested map layers to candidate factors, supporting datasets, missing evidence and reusable question paths. It does not produce planning, legal, valuation, capacity or causation conclusions.

nodes.label: CSO StatBank and statistical geography
nodes.description: Population, labour, housing, commuting, deprivation-adjacent and statistical-area context.

properties.license: CSO open data terms; verify per table

nodes.label: HSE and public health service locations
nodes.description: Hospitals, urgent care, clinics and health-service access context.

nodes.label: Ireland Open Data Portal catalogue
nodes.description: Master catalogue used to discover and track public Irish datasets and publisher metadata.

properties.publisher: Department of Public Expenditure, NDP Delivery and Reform

nodes.label: Local authority infrastructure and civic assets
nodes.description: Public lighting, crossings, traffic signals, roadworks, parking, drainage, active travel and civic assets where published.

nodes.label: Met Éireann observations, forecasts, warnings and climate data
nodes.description: Weather observations and warnings for temporal/spatial context.

properties.license: Often CC BY 4.0; verify per endpoint

nodes.label: NTA GTFS and public transport data
nodes.description: Stops, routes, trips, schedules and realtime public-transport context.

properties.license: NTA open-data terms; verify current terms

nodes.label: OPW flood maps and flood risk datasets
nodes.description: Flood extents, flood risk context and related environmental layers.

nodes.label: RSA collision and casualty data
nodes.description: Collision and casualty records and aggregates used as one context domain.

properties.publisher: Road Safety Authority / Department of Transport

nodes.label: School locations and education statistics
nodes.description: School locations, roll numbers and education context.

properties.license: Open data terms where published; verify per file

nodes.label: Tailte Éireann spatial reference data
nodes.description: Roads, place names, boundaries and spatial reference context where public licensing permits.

nodes.label: TII traffic and national roads data
nodes.description: Traffic counters, AADT, road network, travel times and national road context.

nodes.label: Environmental and flood constraints
nodes.description: Flood, water, environmental and land-cover layers provide constraint context around sites and zoned land.

nodes.label: Housing supply pipeline
nodes.description: Pipeline polygons help connect proposed/permitted/under-construction residential supply to local context.

nodes.label: Planning applications and sites
nodes.description: Point and polygon records show where planning applications are located and what sites they relate to.

nodes.label: Policy and decision timeline
nodes.description: Planning status, decisions, appeals, zoning plans and legislation need time-aware joins before change-over-time questions are reliable.

nodes.label: Population and housing demand context
nodes.description: CSO and demographic data provide demand-side context for interpreting housing/planning records.

nodes.label: Residentially zoned land
nodes.description: RZLT and zoning layers identify land that may be relevant to residential capacity and servicing context.

nodes.label: Schools, health and public-service capacity
nodes.description: Public-service locations and demographics help show whether development context needs school, health, civic or other capacity evidence.

nodes.label: Transport access and road exposure
nodes.description: Transport and road data connect development sites to mobility, public transport and road-network context.

nodes.label: Address/site/entity resolution
nodes.description: Applications, sites, zoning, services and roads need stable place/site IDs before exact joins.

properties.nextAdapter: Create canonical site/place IDs using geometry overlap, address fields and local authority references.

nodes.label: Full vector-tile map rendering
nodes.description: The adapter records counts/schemas/samples; full 990k-feature map rendering needs tiling/generalisation.

properties.nextAdapter: Generate PMTiles/vector tiles from source GeoJSON/GeoPackage releases and publish via R2.

nodes.label: Infrastructure and service capacity evidence
nodes.description: Housing/planning context needs water, schools, transport, health and utilities evidence to avoid one-layer interpretations.

properties.nextAdapter: Join Irish Water/Uisce Éireann where public, schools, HSE, NTA, TII and local-authority assets by place/time.

nodes.label: Ownership, cost and market context
nodes.description: Public planning data alone does not reveal ownership, viability, affordability or delivery likelihood.

properties.nextAdapter: Add open company/land/property/price/rent/procurement datasets where licence permits.

nodes.label: Planning status and decision normalization
nodes.description: Application statuses/decisions must be normalized before timelines or pipeline movement are reliable.

properties.nextAdapter: Map source fields to canonical status, decision date, application date, appeal and completion milestones.
